name: ZoomUIToolkitRoot

component.name: ZoomUIToolkitRoot
component.description: Optional wrapper that places layouts you build from the individual components in their own stacking layer at the ZoomUIToolkitProvider baseZIndex.

behavior: Layered parts of the components inside it don't mix with your page's stacking order.
Menus, panels, dialogs, and bottom sheets still open above the page, outside this wrapper.
It accepts no className or style.
ZoomUIToolkitApp already forms the same stacking layer, so don't wrap the app in it.
